title: Dorian Yates HIIT for Nattys
author: Arbaaz khan
desc: This program is a derivation of Dorian Yates HIIT program. Additionally, it also focuses on legs and arms with a dedicated day for both. Add rest days as you desire. Volume is subjective to the user, recommendation is 1 warm-up set, 2 working sets.
